column2:
[title32][sentence]
This panel provides access to the shield
subsystem circuits and enhancement slots.
It is currently closed.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
這片面板可以通往護盾
子系統電路與強化插槽，
目前是關閉的。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The shield access panel is now open, revealing
the shield subsystem circuits and enhancement
slots.  In one of the slots is the 51-prong
quadratic shield modulator which you keep here
"just in case."  It should come loose if you
tug on it.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
護盾面板已經打開，露出
護盾子系統的電路與強化
插槽。其中一個插槽裡，
是你「以防萬一」擺在這裡
的51齒二次式護盾調變器。
用力一拉，應該就會鬆脫。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The shield access panel is now open, revealing
the shield subsystem circuits and enhancement
slots.  One of the slots is empty, since you
have appropriated the shield modulator for some
hidden purpose of your own.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
護盾面板已經打開，露出
護盾子系統的電路與強化
插槽。其中一個插槽是空
的，因為調變器被你挪去
做了不可告人的用途。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nIt's already open!
column3: [title26][sentence]\n早就開著了！

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Lo and behold!  You're already sitting
in it.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你瞧！你早就坐在
裡面了。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You assume that this ornate parlor
must have belonged to someone wealthy
and powerful.  Beautifully painted
portraits adorn the walls; rare porcelain
pieces sit on small custom shelves; and
in the middle of it all, a unique-looking vase
sits on a majestic pedestal.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你猜這間富麗堂皇的會客室，
主人必定是個有錢有勢的人物。
牆上掛著精美的肖像畫；珍稀瓷器
擺在訂製的小架子上；正中央，
一座造型獨特的花瓶，端坐在
宏偉的底座上。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
You assume that this ornate parlor
must have belonged to someone wealthy
and powerful.  Beautifully painted
portraits adorn the walls and rare
porcelain pieces sit on small custom
shelves.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你猜這間富麗堂皇的會客室，
主人必定是個有錢有勢的人物。
牆上掛著精美的肖像畫，
珍稀瓷器則擺在訂製的
小架子上。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nBlack and white tiles interlock to\nform the solid marble floor.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n黑白兩色的磚塊交錯鑲嵌，\n形成整片堅實的大理石地板。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
Several large pillars reach majestically
toward the ceiling.  They appear to be
solid marble.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
幾根碩大的柱子雄偉地
直逼天花板，看起來
是整塊實心大理石打造。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThe small fragile teacups appears to be\nmade of  extremely fine porcelain.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這些小巧易碎的茶杯，
看起來是用極細緻的
瓷器燒製而成。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nDainty teacups aren't you style; you're\nmore of a 'dirty coffee mug' kind of guy.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
精緻茶杯不是你的菜；
你比較像用「髒兮兮
咖啡杯」的那種人。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Although pretty, this vase does not
match the description Colonel Stone gave
you.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這只花瓶雖然漂亮，
但和史東上校給你的
描述對不上。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Three hand-painted oil paintings grace
the northern wall of the room.  There
appears to be a family resemblance
between these gentlemen, but you do not
recognize any of them.  There are
nameplates beneath each portrait.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
三幅手繪油畫裝點著
房間的北牆。這幾位
紳士似乎頗有家族
相似之處，但你一個
也不認得。每幅肖像
下方都有名牌。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
From left to right they read:
"Sputatious T. Bigfish", "W. Widepipe Bigfish",
and "Benjamin Deeppost Bigfish".  The devious
looks in their eyes convince you that these
portraits represent three generations of
politicians.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
由左到右分別寫著：
「噴沫Ｔ‧大尾魚」、
「Ｗ‧粗管‧大尾魚」、
以及「班傑明‧深樁‧
大尾魚」。這幾位的
眼神都透著狡詐，讓你
確信這是三代政客
的畫像。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Several portraits and porcelain pieces
decorate the walls of this lavish parlor.
You can't help but feel that there is something
odd about the decorative metal studs that
line the tops of the walls.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
好幾幅肖像畫和瓷器
裝飾著這間奢華會客室
的牆面。你總覺得，
牆頂那排裝飾用的
金屬釘子有點不對勁。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nA lovely violet crystal vase sits\natop the decorative pedestal.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n一只可愛的紫水晶花瓶，\n端坐在裝飾底座上。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThe pedestal appears odd without the\nvase sitting on it.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n沒了花瓶擺在上頭，\n這座底座看起來怪怪的。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The bottle doesn't seem appropriate
sitting on the ornate pedestal, but it
did fool the security system.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
瓶子擺在這華麗的
底座上顯得格格不入，
但它確實騙過了
保全系統。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You have become completely familiar
with the teleporters.  This unit, however,
is the most tastefully decorated teleporter
you have seen.  It is obviously a privately
owned unit.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你早就對傳送器
瞭若指掌了。不過
這一台，是你見過
裝潢最有品味的
傳送器，顯然是
私人擁有的。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
This is it!  You are elated to finally be
within arms reach of Colonel Stone's
precious vase!  Light scintillates through
the lavender-colored crystal.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
就是這個！你欣喜若狂，
終於伸手就能碰到史東
上校的寶貝花瓶了！
光線在淡紫色的
水晶中閃爍。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Nice security system.  The moment you
lifted that vase off the pedestal, you had
a bad accident involving a half dozen
laser beams.  You have only a few
seconds to ponder the problem before
your scorched body expires.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
好個保全系統。花瓶才剛
離開底座，你就撞上一場
「六道雷射光束」的悲劇
意外。你只剩幾秒鐘可以
反省人生，然後——你那
具燒焦的軀體就領便當了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThat won't work, the [noun1] is\nmuch too heavy.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這樣行不通，\n[noun1]太重了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThat won't work, the [noun1] is\nfar too light.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這樣行不通，\n[noun1]太輕了。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
Unfortunately, the bottle was too light.
You consider the gravity of your error
as small wisps of smoke curl up from
the depths of your thoracic cavity.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
很不幸，瓶子太輕了。
你正細細品味自己這個
「重大」失誤，胸腔深處
已經裊裊冒出縷縷輕煙。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Unfortunately, the bottle was too heavy.
You have mere moments to consider
your error before the charred remains
of your heart issue a final thump.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
很不幸，瓶子太重了。
你只剩短短片刻反省
這個錯誤，然後你那顆
燒焦的心臟，就會發出
最後一聲悶響。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
At last!  After all you've been through,
you finally have your hands on Colonel
Stone's precious vase!  The many possible
uses for 75,000 galactars flash through your head:
a new ship, Lolita, a lifetime supply of fire wood, Lolita,  . . . .
column3:
[title32][sentence]
終於！歷經千辛萬苦，
你終於把史東上校的
寶貝花瓶抓在手裡了！
七萬五千銀河幣能做的
事，一一在你腦中閃過：
一艘新船、蘿莉塔、
用不完的柴火、蘿莉塔……

column2:
[title32][sentence]
That would be pretty foolish, considering
the elaborate procedures you just went
through to defeat the security system.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
那樣做相當愚蠢，
畢竟你才剛費盡
千辛萬苦，繞過了
那套精密的保全系統。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The bottle now rests on the pedestal, and
apparently has just the right amount of
water in it to fool the security system.
You saw that trick in a movie once, and you
are glad you got it right, since you wouldn't
want to be chased through the room by a giant
boulder.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
瓶子現在穩穩擺在底座
上，裡頭的水量似乎
剛好能騙過保全系統。
你曾在某部電影裡看過
這招，慶幸自己這次
抓對了份量——畢竟你
可不想被一顆巨石
追著滿屋子跑。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You are at the edge of the city, beneath
the gigantic cylindrical perimeter wall,
in front of a large glass viewport.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你站在城市邊緣，
在巨大的圓柱形
外牆下方，一扇大型
玻璃觀景窗前。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
As you look out into the ocean you
pause and think.  The engineering that
went in to this city amazes you.  Building
a metropolis in a volcano cone BELOW
sea-level is quite an accomplishment.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
望著外頭的海洋，
你停下腳步思考了
一下。這座城市的
工程技術真讓你驚嘆
——竟然能在海平面
「以下」的火山口裡
蓋出一整座都市，
真是了不起的成就。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
As you look out into the ocean you
pause and think.  The engineering that
went into this city amazes you.  Building
a metropolis in a volcano comb BELOW
sea-level is quite an accomplishment.
Something in the water seems to have taken
an interest in you.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
望著外頭的海洋，
你停下腳步思考了
一下。這座城市的
工程技術真讓你驚嘆
——竟然能在海平面
以下的火山口裡蓋出
一整座都市，真是
了不起的成就。水裡
似乎有什麼東西，
對你產生了興趣。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You are standing at the base of the
cylindrical perimeter wall.  The
viewport is recessed into the wall,
suggesting that the wall is quite
thick.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你站在圓柱形
外牆的底部。觀景窗
嵌進牆裡，看來
這道牆相當厚實。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou don't want to look at another\nair vent for the rest of your life.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
你這輩子再也
不想多看一眼
通風口了。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The indicator is giving an indication
indicative of something indicating
something else.  Just what that
indication is escapes you completely.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這個指示器正發出
一個指示，指示著
某件事，而那件事
本身又指示著別的
事。至於那個指示
到底在指示什麼，
你完全一頭霧水。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The sculpture resembles a cube with
a lightning bolt glued to it.  You do
not understand the significance of this
shape.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這座雕塑看起來
像個立方體，上面
黏了一道閃電。你
完全看不懂這個
造型有什麼意義。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
This is the car you arrived in.
It still looks the same as when you
got here.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這是你搭來的車。
看起來和你剛到時
一模一樣。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The small fountain under the statue
is not currently running.  The water
in the pool is probably stagnant.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
雕像下方的小噴泉
目前沒有運作。
池子裡的水大概
已經死水一灘了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
A thought:  If you want to blow the
viewport up, don't you think you
should be able to get away first?
Setting that bomb off in your hands
would not be good for your
complexion.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
想想看：如果你要
把觀景窗炸掉，是不是
該先確定自己能逃得掉？
在手裡引爆炸彈，
對你的膚質可不會
有什麼好處。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You carefully place the time bomb on the
small ledge in front of the window.  You
set the timer for five minutes, but get a little
nervous when the timer jumps from 4:49 to
4:02.  This timer must be a little flaky--you
should probably seek safety NOW!
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你小心翼翼地把
定時炸彈放在窗前的
小平台上。你把計時器
設定成五分鐘，但當它
從4：49跳到4：02時，
你不禁緊張了起來。
這個計時器一定有點
秀逗——你現在最好
立刻找地方躲起來！

column2: [title17][sentence]\nDon't you think you should be leaving\nright about now?
column3: [title17][sentence]\n你不覺得現在\n該閃人了嗎？

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou carefully disarm the time bomb,\nand slip it back in your pocket.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你小心翼翼地
拆除定時炸彈，
把它塞回口袋裡。

column2:
[title32]NOVICE LEVEL WARNING
Watch out!  Blowing up that window
will commit you irrevocably to a course
of action.  You don't yet have everything
you need to solve the puzzles in the next
section of the game, so blowing it up now
would prevent you from winning.  Go back
and search carefully, then try putting the
bomb on the ledge again later when you think
you are ready.  In particular, be sure to
bring something yummy to feed to that sea
monster.
column3:
[title32]新手等級警告
小心！炸掉那扇窗，會讓
你走上一條無法回頭的路。
你現在還沒蒐集齊解開
遊戲下一段謎題所需的
東西，現在炸掉窗戶會讓
你無法過關。回去仔細
搜索，等你覺得準備好了，
再回來把炸彈放到平台上
試試看。特別要記得，
帶點好吃的東西去餵
那隻海怪。

column2:
[title32]INTERMEDIATE LEVEL WARNING
Watch out!  Blowing up that window
will commit you irrevocably to a course
of action.  If you haven't found everything
you need to solve the puzzles in the next
section of the game, blowing up the window
now will prevent you from winning.  We therefore
suggest that you save your game now.  Then,
issue this command again to place the bomb.
That way, if you get stuck, you can come back
to this point and find the additional items
that you need.
column3:
[title32]進階等級警告
小心！炸掉那扇窗，會讓
你走上一條無法回頭的路。
如果你還沒找齊解開
遊戲下一段謎題所需的
東西，現在炸掉窗戶會讓
你無法過關。因此我們
建議你現在先存檔，
然後再次下達這個指令
來放置炸彈。這樣一來，
萬一卡關，你還能回到
這裡，找齊你需要的
額外物品。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You are standing on the eastern half of this small
maintenance platform.  A pile of bones lies
scattered around the teleporter entrance.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你站在這座小型
維修平台的東半邊。
一堆骨頭散落在
傳送器入口周圍。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The rim of the city is obviously the top
of the volcano cone.  The short section
you are standing on has been paved, and
you imagine that it must be a maintenance
platform.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
城市的邊緣顯然
就是火山口的頂端。
你站著的這一小段
路面經過鋪設，
你猜這裡應該是
個維修平台。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nYou have no clues as to what purpose\nthis cement block could possibly have served.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你完全想不透，
這塊水泥磚到底
有什麼用途。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
A cone of igneous rock surrounds the rim
of the city.  The sunlight washes warmly over
it's pocked blue-purple surface.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
一圈火成岩錐
環繞著城市邊緣。
陽光溫暖地灑在
它坑坑疤疤的
藍紫色表面上。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou don't need any pumice.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你不需要任何浮石。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nTo the west you see the elevator\nthat brought you here.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
西邊你看到
那部載你來
這裡的電梯。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This looks like every other teleporter
on the planet,  although it does seem
darker inside that most of the other
teleporters.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這看起來跟這星球上
其他傳送器沒兩樣，
只是裡頭似乎比
大多數傳送器都暗
一些。

column2:
[title18][sentence]
A nearly complete humanoid skeleton lies
scattered about near the teleporter entrance.
There are many recognizable bones in the
small heap.
column3:
[title18][sentence]
一具近乎完整的
人形骨骸散落在
傳送器入口附近。
這一小堆裡有不少
認得出來的骨頭。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nYou carefully select a bone\nfrom the heap and pick it up.
column3:
[title18][sentence]
你小心翼翼地
從骨堆裡挑了
一根骨頭撿起來。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nDon't get greedy, you already have two bones.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n別太貪心，\n你已經有兩根骨頭了。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe city is completely under water.\n
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這座城市已經
完全沒入水中。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This could be trouble.  This is the same beast
that expressed an interest in your nutritional
value at the viewport in the city.  He seems to
be trying to decide if you are an appetizer or
an entree.  You should probably act with haste.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這下麻煩了。這正是
先前在城市觀景窗那邊，
對你的「營養價值」
表現出興趣的那隻怪獸。
牠似乎正在盤算你
到底算開胃菜還是
主菜。你最好動作
快一點。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
A few monster chunks still float around
just below the surface.  You can't see
anything of the city you destroyed.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
還有幾塊怪獸的
殘塊漂浮在水面
下方。你已經看不到
你摧毀的那座城市
的任何痕跡了。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You are currently sharing the water
with a large hungry-looking cycloptic
beast.  You may want to do something
instead of just sitting there like an hors d'oeuvre.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你現在正跟一隻
看起來很餓的
獨眼海怪共用
同一片水域。與其
像盤開胃菜一樣
呆坐在那裡，你
或許該做點什麼。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
A large hungry reptile partially blocks
your view of the building to the north.  You
have more immediate concerns than
the building.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
一隻飢餓的
大型爬蟲類擋住了
你往北邊看向那棟
建築的視線。不過
你現在有比那棟
建築更緊急的事
要煩惱。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nYou are getting closer to the building\nwhere you thought you saw the vase.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你正逐漸接近
那棟你以為
看到花瓶的建築。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The building to the north rises alone
above the waves.  Every other building
in the city is invisible beneath the
dark water.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
北邊那棟建築
孤零零地聳立在
波浪之上。城裡
其他建築全都
沒入了黑暗的
水底，什麼也
看不見。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
It hardly seems possible that this

你判斷這個
扣鎖大概壞了，
但還是把粉盒
留了下來——
畢竟誰知道
什麼時候會
需要鏡子，或是
換個新色號的
腮紅呢。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThese look like the items Bruce is wearing\nin the photograph across the room.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這些東西，
看起來就是
照片裡布魯斯
穿的那些行頭。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
O.K.  You grab the slip and put it on.
You throw the bra on for kicks, and wrap the
boa around your neck.  You then skip
out into the street where you dance
for hours.  And then again, maybe not.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
好啊。你抓起
那件襯裙穿上，
純粹為了好玩
又套上胸罩，
把羽毛圍巾
繞在脖子上。
接著你蹦蹦
跳跳地衝到
街上，跳了
好幾個小時的
舞。……好啦，
其實你根本
沒有。
